# Kazi Shakib — Full Portfolio Reference

> Finance Instructor · Software Builder · Chess Player · Mirpur, Dhaka-1216, Bangladesh

## Biography

I live in Mirpur, Dhaka, where I teach finance, build software tools, and play competitive chess. As a Finance Instructor at Mentors Brother, I teach corporate finance, valuation methods (IRR, Payback Period, EBITDA), and Time Value of Money (TVM) to 100+ students, helping at-risk students achieve a 100% pass rate.

Before that, I worked as a Finance Intern at Hanif Enterprise. I prepared more than 1,000 electronic payment challans and built the open-source Hanif Challan Autofiller using Python, Excel, and HTML. It cut over 3 hours of manual typing a day and won the Best Internship Award (BDT 5,000 prize).

At the BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club, where I was Director of IT and now help out as Alumni IT Advisor, I built the club's 11-page website with React, TypeScript, Firebase, and Vercel. I also set up Google Apps Script and AutoCrat to send out event certificates automatically.

- Languages: Bengali (Native) · English (SAT 1420, DET 135)

### Hanif Enterprise Bus Challan Autofiller (Office Automation, 2026 · v1.3.1 (MIT))
Generates Bengali and English bus challans from Excel with automatic numbering and printable 36-seat A4 forms, where the outgoing and return trips share one challan number.
- Tech: Python, Microsoft Excel, HTML5, Noto Serif Bengali, A4 Print
- Impact: 3+ Hrs Saved Daily · 1,000+ Challans
- Source: https://github.com/thekazishakib/Hanif-Enterprise-Challar-Autofiller
- Link: https://github.com/thekazishakib/Hanif-Enterprise-Challar-Autofiller#readme

### SmartBus Revenue & Collection Reconciliation (Revenue & Collection Reconciliation, 2026 · v1.3.0 (MIT))
A Python system for bus revenue and counter collection reconciliation, with Excel workflows, a local web workstation dashboard, SQLite audit history, and printable financial reports.
- Tech: Python 3.11+, SQLite, Microsoft Excel, Web Dashboard, PDF Export
- Impact: 100 Daily Trips · SQLite & Excel
- Source: https://github.com/thekazishakib/SmartBus
- Link: https://github.com/thekazishakib/SmartBus#readme

### Market Basket Analysis (2.6M+ Transactions) (Data Analysis, 2026 (MIT License))
Market basket analysis on 2.6M+ online store orders using the Apriori algorithm to find which products 91,619 shoppers bought together across 13 categories.
- Tech: Python, Pandas, MLxtend, Apriori Algorithm, Matplotlib, Jupyter

## Publications (https://kazishakib.com/publication)

### Why The 100 Taka Note Keeps Shrinking (BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club (BAFSDBC), November 9, 2026)
An article looking at why 100 Taka buys so much less today than a few years ago. It examines inflation trends, the Taka's exchange rate against the US dollar, rising import costs, and how middle-class households cope with rising prices, drawing on data from 13 economic and news sources.
- Status: Published Article
- Link: https://bafsdbc.vercel.app/blogs/why-the-100-taka-note-keeps-shrinking

### Is gold really the safest investment in old age? (BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club (BAFSDBC), December 9, 2025)
Chosen by faculty advisors from about 100 student submissions for the BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club (BAFSDBC). I used 3 academic papers (Baur & Lucey 2010; Baur & McDermott 2010; Erb & Harvey 2013) and 2 investor guides (FINRA; U.S. SEC Investor.gov) to look at whether holding only physical gold is actually safe in retirement.
- Status: Selected Publication (Top Pick from ~100 Submissions)
- Link: https://bafsdbc.vercel.app/blogs/is-gold-really-the-safest-investment-in-old-age

### What the Numbers Don't Tell Us About Money (BAF Shaheen College Dhaka Business Club (BAFSDBC), June 29, 2025)
An article on why understanding the concepts behind financial figures matters in everyday life and small business decisions. It breaks down budgeting, net worth versus liquidity, real versus nominal returns, compound interest, gross margins, and customer lifetime value.
- Status: Published Article
- Link: https://bafsdbc.vercel.app/blogs/what-the-numbers-dont-tell-us-about-money
